entry.title: umans-ai + coding-plan: add GLM 5.3 Flash, drop K2.7 + GLM 5.2 (sunse…
entry.content:
umans-ai + coding-plan: add GLM 5.3 Flash, drop K2.7 + GLM 5.2 (sunset 2026-09-10) (#6581)

* umans-ai + coding-plan: add GLM 5.3 Flash, drop K2.7 + GLM 5.2 (sunset 2026-09-10)

Add umans-glm-5.3-flash (Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash, 320B-A18B MoE, native
multimodal, 1M context) to both Umans providers: pay-per-token at the
publisher's list rates ($0.15/$0.50/$0.03 per 1M) on umans-ai, cost 0 on
the coding plan. Reasoning is effort-only low|high|max (thinking is always
on — no toggle), matching the live can_disable=false card.

Drop umans-kimi-k2.7 and umans-glm-5.2 from both providers: both are
deprecated and removed from the Umans catalog on 2026-09-10 (sunset
announced on https://api.code.umans.ai/v1/models/info —
deprecation.sunset_date), succeeded by umans-kimi-k3 and umans-glm-5.3
respectively.

* umans-ai + coding-plan: repoint umans-coder to GLM 5.3 Flash

The coding alias rides the GLM-5.3-Flash release since 2026-09-09 (it routed
to Kimi K2.7 Code before; K2.7 sunsets 2026-09-10): base_model moves to
zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash, reasoning becomes effort-only low|high|max (thinking
always on — can_disable=false), the pay-per-token entry carries the flash's
rates ($0.15/$0.50/$0.03) and its 1M context / 131071 output cap, and the
modalities gain the native vision (image + video).

entry.title: fix(inception): correct provider logo and Mercury Edit 2 metadata (#6…
entry.content:
fix(inception): correct provider logo and Mercury Edit 2 metadata (#6749)

The provider logo was not the Inception mark. Replace it with the official
mark (the same artwork inceptionlabs.ai serves as its favicon), converted to
currentColor with no fixed width/height.

Mercury Edit 2 is served only on /v1/edit/completions and /v1/fim/completions,
where context is capped at 32K rather than the 128K chat limit. It exposes no
reasoning control on either endpoint, and the docs model table lists no
tool-calling or structured-output support. Its description had also been copied
from Mercury 2 and advertised tool use that the model does not have.

Fix the provider `doc` link, which returned 403.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: feat(providers): add Inco (#6978)
entry.content:
feat(providers): add Inco (#6978)

* feat(providers): add Inco

Inco (inco.ai) is a prepaid OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible inference
provider. Adds 7 model routes, all inheriting lab metadata via
base_model with provider-specific cost and reasoning controls:

- deepseek-v4.1-flash:fast ($0.60/$2.40)
- glm-5.3 ($1.40/$4.40), glm-5.3:fast ($2.80/$8.80)
- glm-5.3-flash:fast ($0.15/$0.50)
- kimi-k3:fast ($6.00/$30.00)
- minimax-m3 ($0.30/$1.20), minimax-m3:fast ($0.60/$2.40)

Reasoning controls verified against the live API:
- GLM models toggle via chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking
- DeepSeek and Kimi toggle via chat_template_kwargs.thinking
- reasoning_effort and thinking.type are accepted but ignored
- MiniMax M3 always reasons; no caller control (reasoning_options = [])

All models return interleaved reasoning in reasoning_content. Logo is
the "inco" Montserrat Alternates SemiBold wordmark knocked out of a
square, in currentColor.

* fix(providers): document Inco toggle wire path on glm-5.3:fast

entry.title: feat(sync): add ai& sync module with auto-merge allowlist and motif f…
entry.content:
feat(sync): add ai& sync module with auto-merge allowlist and motif family (#7040)

* feat(sync): add ai& sync module with auto-merge allowlist and motif family

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(sync): regenerate aiand catalog on rebased dev

Rerun of the ai& sync after cherry-picking onto current dev.
Interleaved reasoning_content blocks from #6839 are preserved by the
adapter (existing?.interleaved); motif-3 factors onto the new lab entry.

* docs(aiand): refresh kimi-k3 and gpt-oss-120b probe headers

Live reasoning_effort probes on 2026-09-14 (negative controls included)
confirm the authored effort sets are unchanged on the gateway.

* fix(aiand): factor motif-3 override-only onto its lab entry

The rebased regen kept dev's stale inline lab fields (open_weights = false,
release_date 2026-08-12) as overrides against the new lab file. Lab facts now
inherit from models/motif-technologies/motif-3.toml; the [interleaved] block
from #6839 is preserved.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(aiand): clear curated deprecated on omission; silence empty skip notice

The feed owns deprecation and absence means active, so a curated deprecated
no longer survives a feed that omits status (alpha/beta still do). A clean
sync no longer emits a zero-count skip notice into the report.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(aiand): publish interleaved for new reasoners, route lab-metadata skips to missing-model issues

Parse the feed's interleaved (authored fallback, gateway default of
message.reasoning_content for reasoners) so a new reasoner is never created
without its side channel; return skipped ids from missingModelID so the runner
preserves local entries and opens deduped issues. qwen3.8 header records the
2026-09-14 probe including the announced high→xhigh substitution.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(aiand): read overrides from the authored TOML, refresh all headers to the 2026-09-14 probes

Lab-owned fields on factored files come only from deltas the authored file
already carried on its base_model (context.authored, never the base-resolved
merge), so a full-inline file factored for the first time inherits the lab
entry instead of re-emitting stale values as overrides — the Motif regression
in general form. Host fields stay feed-authoritative. All 11 headers now cite
the 2026-09-14 probe matrix (11 models x 7 effort values).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(aiand): stop the runner re-injecting pre-factor descriptions; seed created files with a reasoning-wire header

preserveDescriptions is off so a full-inline → factored transition cannot
recreate a lab-identical description override (runner-level test covers the
Motif shape end to end). translateModel now returns a leading header for
creates naming the reasoning wire path, so a toggle control is never written
without it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(aiand): fail a control-less reasoner for review instead of letting [] be written

A reasoner whose feed yields no schema-valid reasoning_options and has no
authored set to keep now throws MissingReasoningOptionsError: the runner
preserves the local file, reports the reason, and routes the id to the
missing-model issue flow. An explicit [] from the feed remains the feed's own
assertion. Runner-level test covers the untouched-file path.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(aiand): never write toggle or budget controls — ai& has a single reasoning wire path

reasoning_effort ("none" = off) is the only control this host exposes, so
toggle and budget_tokens are parsed for tolerance but dropped from feed and
authored options alike; an emptied set falls through to the existing
fail-for-review path. The create header states the single wire path instead
of describing controls the host does not have.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: Add OCI Generative AI provider (#7087)
entry.content:
Add OCI Generative AI provider (#7087)

* Add OCI Generative AI provider (OpenAI-compatible endpoint, API-key auth)

Signed-off-by: Federico Kamelhar <federico.kamelhar@oracle.com>

* oci: do not advertise tool calling for the Meta Llama models

OCI's OpenAI-compatible endpoint rejects tool-calling requests whose first
message is a system message for every Meta Llama model (400 "Tool calling for
this Llama model requires the first message to be a user message"). opencode
always sends its system prompt first together with its built-in tools, so with
tool_call = true these models fail on the first turn. Chat without tools works.
Re-enable once the endpoint accepts a leading system message.

Signed-off-by: Federico Kamelhar <federico.kamelhar@oracle.com>
